latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pywayne-dsp: A digital signal processing toolkit for sensor data and time-series analysis.

- Provides Butterworth and One-Euro filters for noise suppression and signal smoothing.
- Includes peak and extrema detection tools (peak_det, sliding window detection).
- Supports various detrending methods (mean, linear, poly, loess, wavelet, EMD, median).
- Offers dynamic time warping (DTW) for curve similarity measurement.
- Implements fast online standard deviation calculation (Welford algorithm).
- Suitable for sensor preprocessing, ECG analysis, feature extraction, and quality monitoring.
